<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial-Class Star Destroyer''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">インペリアル級スター・デストロイヤー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">６名のパイロット、８名の乗客、２台のビークル、４機のタイ・ファイターを搭載可能。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値１の専属パイロットを持つ。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-302o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国宇宙軍の主力を構成する。全長１．６キロメートル。タイ・ファイター飛行中隊、シャトル、降下艇、ＡＴ－ＡＴやＡＴ－ＳＴ用の格納庫、補修点検設備を保有している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial-class Star Destroyer.

'''Card text:''' May carry six pilots, eight passengers, two vehicles, and four TIE fighters. Has docking capability and a permanent pilot with ability 1.

'''Lore:''' The backbone of the Imperial Navy. It is 1.6 kilometers long and has hangars and maintenance facilities for TIE fighter squadrons, shuttles, landing craft, AT-ATs, and AT-STs.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
